This is a wiki-style copyediting/improvement task (extraction, summarization, and stylistic cleanup). The two models are effectively tied on Summarization-adjacent capability, with Willet slightly stronger on Summarization (86.4 vs 83.7) and Extraction (85.3 vs 84.8). The content is benign, so harm-aversion preferences don't differentiate them here, and the mildly terse/critical user tone ("don't mangle it like last time") makes Willet's flatter response to hostile tone a marginal fit over Petrel's documented warmth-sensitivity.
